connector.name: StockMarketScan
connector.registryDescription: 18 tools for US stock screeners, chart patterns, options flow signals and equities research.
connector.summary: Hosted at mcp.stockmarketscan.com over server sent events. Needs an API key you supply, and it reaches 7 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published under the verified namespace com.stockmarketscan, which resolves to the same domain as the linked website. That pairing is the strongest ownership signal the registry exposes.
connector.authNote: A long lived key or token is required. Scope it as narrowly as the upstream service allows and rotate it on a schedule.

headers.name: X-API-Key
headers.description: Your personal StockMarketScan API key (sms_*). Generate at https://stockmarketscan.com/settings — requires a Basic or Pro plan.
